description: "What road trips have I saved?": the trips the signed-in driver saved on ChargingNear.me, newest first: start, destination, distance, driving time, the charging stops in driving order (name, network, city, state, station page link) and the trip page link. Needs the driver to sign in to ChargingNear.me; without sign-in it answers with a short message and the sign-in page link.
name: get_my_trips
title: My saved trips
